title: hamiltonians-conserved-quantity widget params
description: Bespoke widget for the §4 conserved-quantity tracker on the hamiltonians-classical-mechanics topic. Renders one .row containing two `<select>`s side-by-side (System: oscillator / central / gravity; Track: H / p / L) plus an SVG host that plots the chosen quantity along a flow integration. The two-pickers-on-one-row layout is bespoke; no shared slug exposes a multi-pick row.
